# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen years old when starting at Brierley school, making him approximately sixteen when completing Regent's.  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c19 P44](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0044), [v1 c38 P60](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0060)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and prospective schoolteacher in Pale Sands  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038), [v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall youth with wavy chestnut hair, mischievous light-brown or hazel eyes, and a mouth often twisted into a teasing grin. By his teenage years, he appears remarkably tall, handsome, and manly, closely resembling his father.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)_

## Personality

Hugh is lively, mischievous, and fond of teasing the girls at school. Despite his playful nature, he is brave, independent, and quick to take responsibility for his misdeeds. He is determined and smart, possessing individual perspectives and a strong drive to excel academically and succeed in life. He also demonstrates genuine generosity and self-sacrifice for the sake of others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)_

- Handsome  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)</sub>
- Mischievous and teasing  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- Brave and accountable  <sub>[v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042)</sub>

- Strong academic student, particularly in mathematics and geometry  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)</sub>

## Goals

- To achieve academic success and earn a teacher's license  <sub>[v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>
- To earn money through teaching to fund his own college education  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- To earn the friendship and forgiveness of Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c28 P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031), [v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)</sub>

## History

After spending three years in Alberta due to his father's health, Hugh returned home and entered Brierley school. On his first day back, he teased Nell Harcourt by pulling her braid and calling her 'carrots', leading her to smash her slate over his head. Though Hugh stood up to take the blame for the incident and apologized afterward, Nell refused to forgive him. Over the following terms, Hugh maintained an intense academic competition with Nell while continuing to excel in recitations at community concerts. During a lily-maid play gone wrong on the pond, Hugh rescued Nell in his dory and again sought her friendship, but was met with cold rejection, leading him to ignore her socially while intensifying their academic rivalry. Entering the Regent's class in Port Marlow, Hugh took the Second Year course to obtain a First Class teacher's license in one year, eventually winning the prestigious Medal. Upon learning that Nell needed to stay in Brierley to care for Thirza and wished to teach at the local school, Hugh generously withdrew his own application for the Brierley position and accepted a teaching role in Pale Sands instead. Meeting Nell on the road shortly after, he accepted her gratitude and forgiveness, establishing a warm friendship with her at last.

## Background by volume

- Lived in Alberta for three years when his father fell ill, missing much schooling  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Son of John Carrow  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)</sub>
- Resides in the Carrow homestead across the Lake of Glassy Waters in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c17 P24](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0024), [v1 c38 P49](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0049)</sub>

## Quotes

> Mr. Pidgeon, the blame belongs to me because I provoked her.  <sub>[v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042)</sub>

> Nell, I’m terribly apologetic about mocking your hair. Truly I am. Please don’t stay angry forever.  <sub>[v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)</sub>

> Nell, my actions were not especially noble. Being of slight assistance to you brought me pleasure. Will friendship exist between us from now on? Is my former misdeed truly pardoned by you?  <sub>[v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)</sub>

> We will end up being the closest of friends. It was our fate to be great friends, Nell. You have resisted fate long enough. I am certain we can assist one another in numerous ways. You plan to continue your studies, don't you? I intend to as well. Come along, I will accompany you on your walk home.  <sub>[v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)</sub>
